validations: : One executable validation or evidence check, maximum 160 characters
AC-01: validate protected requirement — A worker checkpoint with a changed `plan_ref` is rejected exactly as before when no protected human PLAN-refresh sequence authorizes the new reference.

AC-02: validate protected requirement — A changed reference is not admitted merely because the worker has recovered, the run is at IMPLEMENT, or a later PLAN exists. The latest PLAN history must contain the exact `RESUMED(plan_refresh_authorized=true) -> PASSED` sequence.

AC-03: validate protected requirement — The only admissible changed reference is `agentic-plan:<team_plan_id>` from the newest PASSED PLAN attempt in that exact refresh sequence. A stale, arbitrary or malformed PLAN identity fails closed.

AC-04: validate protected requirement — The exceptional changed-reference admission is limited to the first protected agent-dispatch checkpoint that follows the human-refreshed PLAN. It does not create a generic checkpoint API for changing PLAN identity.

AC-05: validate protected requirement — After the first accepted checkpoint persists the fresh PLAN reference, subsequent checkpoints use ordinary equality validation. A second unrelated PLAN change is rejected unless a later independently authorized human PLAN refresh creates another exact protected sequence.

AC-06: validate protected requirement — A durable worker carrying an old PLAN checkpoint and expired old lease can traverse protected process-loss recovery to a fresh lease generation and persist its first checkpoint under the human-refreshed PLAN without `AGENTIC_TASK_FAILED` at PLAN-reference validation.

AC-07: validate protected requirement — Worker identity, prior checkpoint history, checkpoint revision progression, accepted/last-known-good lineage, lease-generation history, prior PLAN/IMPLEMENT attempts and run events remain intact.

AC-08: validate protected requirement — A protected worker checkpoint contract failure during pre-mutation agentic generation is converted into the existing bounded implementation failure path, causing a durable FAILED IMPLEMENT attempt rather than HTTP 422 with an active IMPLEMENT run and terminal worker.

AC-09: validate protected requirement — The change grants no new source mutation, lineage acceptance, Git/provider credentials, arbitrary network/tool use, deployment, production promotion or REVIEW-completion authority.

AC-10: validate protected requirement — Focused worker/agentic/runtime tests and the full protected release gates pass. After exact-source production deployment, authenticated user-equivalent QA on a fresh failed IMPLEMENT fixture must show `resume -> fresh PLAN PASSED -> worker fresh generation -> first refreshed dispatch checkpoint` and hosted implementation dispatch, or capture the next later bounded failure with preserved diagnostic evidence.
